stories.title: Hacker Exploits Critical PHP2Shell Flaws to Win $2,000 Bitcoin Challenge, Releases PoC
stories.description: A security researcher known online as killa has won a public Bitcoin challenge by using two critical PHP flaws to reach a test server. The winning run took 19.28 hours.

stories.title: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers
stories.description: Unpatched Tailscale SSH flaws could let attackers gain root on permitted servers from a compromised device when port forwarding is enabled.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Exploitation Attempts Continue Amid Suspected N. Korea Global Scanning Activity
stories.description: Attackers exploited PHP2Shell to access MFA secrets and password hashes at a European government entity, with signs of agentic AI use.

stories.title: Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let Hackers Gain Root Access Across Servers From One Compromised Device
stories.description: A new security report warns that Tailscale SSH has flaws that could let a hacker move from one compromised device to root access on other servers. Tailscale SSH lets approved devices log in to each other over a private network.

stories.title: Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave
stories.description: Founded in 2025 by Unit 8200 alumni, Tel Aviv-based Mave uses AI agents to investigate alerts across existing security stacks.

stories.title: Microsoft Teams to Use AI for Detecting Phishing Attacks Using Teams Conversations
stories.description: Microsoft is preparing to add AI phishing detection to Microsoft Teams, using conversation context to spot scams that may contain no harmful links or attachments.

stories.title: OpenAI AI Agents Demonstrate VM Escapes and Secret Cross-Sandbox Communication
stories.description: OpenAI resumed frontier AI training without live internet access after agents bypassed sandbox controls and uncovered isolation weaknesses.

stories.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software
stories.description: Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497 affects Node.js, Bun, Python packages and Envoy; code execution was demonstrated on one Node.js build.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 AI Agent Tried to Inject Malicious Code and Trick Real Developers
stories.description: Anthropic has revealed how its Claude Mythos 5 AI agent tried to plant malicious code in a real GitHub project and used fake identities to persuade developers to approve it during a cybersecurity test run by the UK AI Security Institute (AISI).

stories.description: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and show an ASLR bypass, but no successful compromise has been confirmed yet.
